summary: SuperX AI Technology Limited (NASDAQ: SUPX), a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing continued open-market share repurchases under a new 2026 Repurchase Program authorized by the Board on August 6, 2026. The program authorizes repurchases of up to US$20 million of ordinary shares over twelve months. As of September 2, 2026, SuperX had repurchased 5,630 shares at an average price of US$7.9325 per share. The company also highlighted recent APAC orders (Japan and Australia) as evidence of growth, framing buybacks as a strategic capital allocation to enhance shareholder value while supporting operational expansion. What to watch: pace of repurchases and any impact on share price support.
